name: 03 - Error Workflow
_note: Error workflow: pages on-call in Slack when a workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow fails (01 and 02 do). Posts to the approvals channel by default; point 'Notify On-Call' at the on-call channel if it differs. An Error Trigger only fires for OTHER workflows, which is why this must be its own workflow, not a node on a shared canvas.
